Project overview

AYANA Commons is the small mixed-use part of T.H. Group's AYANA development in Bang Tao. It combines 39 residential units with eight retail spaces for shops and services at street level, in low-rise pavilion-style buildings set around courtyards. The developer is the same company behind the much larger AYANA Heights Seaview Residence on the hillside nearby.

The smallest advertised unit is a one-bedroom apartment of 32 sqm, listed freehold at THB 3.76 million, which makes it one of the lower entry points into new-build ownership in Bang Tao. Shared facilities include a swimming pool, a wellness studio and surface and underground parking; residents are also offered the AYANA lifestyle card.

The brief refers to a "Phase 2". We could not find a published second phase of AYANA Commons, and listings disagree on whether construction is finished, so please ask us which units and phase are currently on sale.
